2.2 Details of Work: 1. The broad scope of this tender covers Deployment of Contractual Assistants (CAs) for assisting Electrical Mainten ance Activities of AC Coaches (excluding AC RMPU) at Mangalore central (MAQ) depot for a period of 2 years as per t he terms and conditions of contract. 2. Cleaning of the electrical Equipment of SG, LHB & Vande Bharat AC Coaches after Every trip: a) Battery bank b) Regulators c) Battery Chargers d) Power & control panels, switch board cabinets e) Terminal Connectors f) Emergency inverter selector switch g) Main battery fuse h) WRA/Mono block pumps as per schedule of work. i) Shifting of materials from store to pit/sick line for maintenance activities as when required by the railways. j) Loading and unloading of store materials k) Cleaning and keeping of Unit spares in good manner and any other items as per requirement. 3. Cleaning of the electrical Equipment of SG, LHB & Vande Bharat AC Coaches every month: a) Light Fittings & Fans b) Switches & Sockets c) Measuring and recording of battery voltage with/without load d) Weeding out of Cells e) Charging of batteries and other Electrical equipment as and when required. f) Assisting the maintenance activities at sick line / pit line of any of the electrical item in the coach maintenance 4. Assisting in the various Electrical schedules like D2, D3, 3 monthly, 6 monthly/ IOH schedules of SG, LHB AC Coac hes. 5. Before submitting the offer, Tenderers are requested to go through the following special conditions and Genera l conditions as made applicable for this contract duly assessing the work by visiting AC depot at Mangaluru. 6. Any doubts on the preview of scope of work of outsourcing services of AC coach maintenance Assistants are to b e got clarified personally from Senior Divisional Electrical (G) Engineer, Mysuru so as to get better understanding on scope/essence of the contract. The motive in outsourcing of services is to prefer quality services from the competen t agency who can execute the work without any compromising on safety standards, rules and regulations and other provisions made for the smooth execution of contract. 2.3 Completion Period: Each Schedule of work shall be completed within 24 Months from its date of Commencement. The work shall be started in consultation with SSE/E/AC/MAQ as per terms and conditi ons of contract after acceptance of LOA. 1. In case if the entire work is not able to complete within the given period, the extension of time will be granted as p er clause 5 of Indian Railways General Conditions of Contract for Services - January 2018 or latest. The Contractor sh all apply for extension before 15 days of expiry of the period of completion. 2.4 Duties of Contract Assistants (CAs) 1. Contract Assistants deployed by the contractor shall work under the control of Railway SSE Electrical (Engineer in-c harge) of that station or his authorized representative and shall follow the instructions given by him. 2. Cleaning of the electrical Equipment of SG, LHB & Vande Bharat AC Coaches after Every trip as detailed in Details o f Work 3. Cleaning of the electrical Equipment of SG, LHB & Vande Bharat AC Coaches during every month as detailed in Details of Work. 4. Non-core maintenance activities of AC coaches of SGAC/LHB/VB rakes as detailed in Details of Work. 5. Assisting in the various Electrical schedules like D2, D3, 3 monthly, 6 monthly/ IOH schedules of SG, LHB AC Coache s, sick coaches attention in sick line, pit line & yard. 6. To operate firefighting equipments (fire extinguishers) in case of fire accidents under the instructions of Railway in- charge. 7. To attend to any emergency arising out of accidents, flooding etc., under the instructions of Railway in-charge. 8. The contractor shall be responsible for safe custody of equipments (provided by Railway) and their staff till completi on of work. To appear in the prescribed uniform approved by Railways and have his badge (Name plate) fixed on it to be easily i dentified by travelling public
